This is the first hard fiscal number of the kinetic exchange. If Brent stays sub-$90, the bill eases; if Brent rallies to $95+, the bill spikes back. RON95 rationalisation window: Q3-Q4 2026 per PMO economist (29 May). RON95 RM3.72, diesel RM4.67 — unchanged for 11-17 Jun 2026. Anwar swap-line option: the JERA+Japan-bilateral arrangement is the template for monetising LNG in yen, partly insulating MYR from oil-shock. Political will is the question.
